meta.name: Neighborhood District
meta.axes: x east, z north, y up, origin at map center
meta.symmetry: Major combat routes, house placement, and team spawn edges are arranged around the central park for reasonable 4v4 fairness.

rules: Stylized low-poly suburban neighborhood designed for the existing first-person movement and collision system.
Team A starts at the south edge; Team B marker is at the north edge. These are layout/spawn markers, not networked multiplayer implementation.
Two-story houses have enterable ground and upper floors; the two apartment blocks have three floors and stair-accessible rooftop terraces.
Keep the central park, bus/market lanes, and two side routes traversable; buildings, parked vehicles, fences, and props intentionally provide tactical cover.
Map bounds are +/-48m; invisible boundary colliders prevent leaving the neighborhood.
